state:
**Side goal `fmt-layout-from-breaks`, stage 2 landed except shape types.** `nvs fmt` lays out call arguments (`Call`, `MethodCall`, `StaticCall`, `new`), array literals, anonymous objects, the parameter list of a `Function`, `Method` and `Fn`, and an enum's case list as one line or one item per line, chosen by a break at the list's own level (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs`). An enum on one line keeps `{` on the `enum` line (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/brace.rs` through `List::on_one_line`). The trailing comma follows `List::broken` for every one of these lists (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/tokens.rs`). `crates/nvs-fmt/tests/list_layout.rs` holds the 13 tests the stage-2 check names, `tests/fmt/input/lists.nvs` is the fixture pair, and the corpus is reformatted.

Still not a list: a shape type, because no node in `crates/nvs-syntax/src/walk.rs` writes one (gap `comma-separated-list-whose-closing-delimiter`, narrowed to shape types). So `rule:tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line` stays `designed`. Stage 3 (chains) and stage 4 (editor actions) are not started.

next.note: one file set: a new `crates/nvs-fmt/src/chain.rs`, `crates/nvs-fmt/src/indent.rs`, `crates/nvs-fmt/src/print.rs`, a new `crates/nvs-fmt/tests/chain_layout.rs`.

items.text: **A broken `->` / `?->` call chain has one call per line** — receiver stays, each arrow starts a line one level in; a chain on one line stays (`rule:tooling/fmt-a-broken-call-chain-is-one-call-per-line`); wire its runs beside `list::runs` at `crates/nvs-fmt/src/print.rs:142` and its line placement beside `list::opening` at `crates/nvs-fmt/src/indent.rs:139`. The check's first test is `a_call_chain_on_one_line_stays_on_one_line`; read the record's stage-3 check for the full name list.

**A broken `&&`, `||`, `??` or `.` chain has one operand per line, operator first** — the lowest-precedence run is the chain (`rule:tooling/fmt-a-broken-operator-chain-is-one-operand-per-line`) — `crates/nvs-fmt/src/print.rs:142`
**A broken `if` / `elseif` / `while` / `do … while` condition puts `(` and `) {` on lines of their own** (same rule) — `crates/nvs-fmt/src/brace.rs:68`

backlog: A shape type as a list needs a type node in `crates/nvs-syntax/src/walk.rs` first: gap `comma-separated-list-whose-closing-delimiter`.
Stage 4: the *Put on separate lines* and *Join onto one line* actions and their `tests/lsp/actions/` cases (`rule:ide/a-list-splits-onto-lines-and-joins-onto-one`).
`crates/nvs-fmt/tests/token_rules.rs`'s `a_multi_line_list_gains_a_trailing_comma_and_a_one_line_list_has_none` overlaps `list_layout.rs` but still covers `match` arms, so it was kept.
